recovered_implementation.not_adequate_as: queue.fingerprint is sha256 of the whole document minus the fingerprint field, so timestamps, zero-valued status buckets and candidate list order move it. vocabulary.FRESH: byte sha and semantic fingerprint both match

vocabulary.UNREGISTERED: a receipts/future/*.json file with no registry row
